title: Selected device-token admin action sends to every device for each selected user
reasoning: The DeviceToken admin action loads the selected DeviceToken rows, but then reduces them to distinct user ids and calls send_push_notification with users. send_push_notification re-queries all active tokens for those users, so choosing one token for a user can notify that user's other devices too. The large-batch path has the same behavior through send_push_notification_to_users_task, which passes user ids into the same user-based filter.
recommendation: Preserve selected token ids or token strings through the admin view and background task, and have the send helper support an explicit token queryset/list so only the selected devices are targeted.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The device token tests cover registration and the test-push endpoint, but there is no admin-action test for users with multiple tokens where only one token is selected.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a user with two active DeviceToken rows, invoke the admin send-push flow selecting only one token, mock PushClient.publish, and assert only the selected token is published.
minimumFixScope: Change the admin send-push flow and chunked task to target selected DeviceToken ids/tokens directly instead of converting selections to user ids.
